subject: Single-invoice authorization request — vendor onboarding
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan@microledger.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: sales@microledger.ai
Date: 2026-11-17T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: single-invoice onboarding & PO waiver for MicroLedger trial

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at MicroLedger is keen to run a short integration pilot with Redwood next week. Procurement at MicroLedger typically issues a single invoice at the end of engagement rather than a PO up front (their accounting system is set up that way for small pilots).

We expect the first pilot invoice to be ~$3,800 (analytics + 2-week usage). Can you confirm if Redwood can onboard MicroLedger as a supplier on an invoice-only basis for this trial? If not, what evidence or approvals do you need to enable a single-invoice path?

I can attach W9, COI, and a one-page SOW.

Attachments: MicroLedger_W9.pdf (voucher), MicroLedger_CertificateOfInsurance.pdf, SOW_MicroLedger_trial.pdf

Appreciate a quick turnaround — Jordan
MicroLedger | Head of Partnerships
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@microledger.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T09:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: single-invoice onboarding & PO waiver for MicroLedger trial

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the materials and for flagging budget. We can potentially support an invoice-only onboarding for one-off pilots, but we need to follow the temporary approval flow so we capture risk/evidence. Marissa and David from Procurement/Finance are looped in to validate.

Quick checklist we need to confirm before we can create a vendor on the invoice-only path:
- W9 or equivalent (received)
- Certificate of insurance covering professional liability (received)
- Signed SOW or statement of work for the pilot (received)
- PO waiver approval if the invoice amount exceeds our LOW-TOUCH threshold (procurement to confirm)

Jordan, if the pilot stays under $5k and the documents above are complete, Procurement typically grants a temporary invoice-only route for a single invoice and auto-closes vendor after the pilot. If the pilot might exceed $5k we’ll need an elevated approval (Marissa / Karthik).

Marissa / David: can you confirm whether MicroLedger qualifies for the temporary invoice-only lane given the $3.8k estimate and the attached docs? If you approve, please add the conditions (duration, spend cap, evidence retention).

Naomi Feldman
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: single-invoice onboarding & PO waiver for MicroLedger trial

Naomi —

Reviewed the package. Documents look complete (W9, COI, SOW). Per our procurement risk matrix, a $3.8k exposure for a short proof-of-concept is low risk provided we limit the arrangement to a single invoice and retention of evidence for audit. See attached for reference: procurement-risk-matrix.pdf.

Two notes:
- Our standard LOW-TOUCH cap is $5k but we can allow a one-time exception up to $7.5k for strategic pilots with Sales/CS sponsorship.
- For amounts between $5k–$7.5k we require a written sponsor approval (email thread stored in record). Above $7.5k requires legal/finance sign-off and a purchase order.

Requesting Karthik for a quick sign-off that Procurement can create MicroLedger as invoice-only with the following conditions: (1) single invoice route only, (2) spend cap $7.5k, (3) vendor will be deactivated after the pilot unless a standard PO process is completed, (4) SOW retained in record.

Attachment: procurement-risk-matrix.pdf

- Marissa
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T13:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: single-invoice onboarding & PO waiver for MicroLedger trial

Marissa / team —

I reviewed the risk matrix and the docs. Approve conditional invoice-only onboarding for MicroLedger for this pilot with the conditions you listed. Please ensure the following operational controls are put in place before vendor activation:
1) Create vendor record with tag "TEMP-INVOICE-TRIAL-202611" and auto-expiry date (90 days).
2) Attach W9, COI, and SOW to the vendor record and to the HubSpot opportunity (HubSpot: 87431).
3) Procurement to send a short addendum to the vendor outlining acceptance of a single invoice for this engagement and spend cap; require signature via DocuSign.

I’m copying Legal for awareness; because the amount is under $7.5k and docs are complete, we don’t need a full contract amendment. Once DocuSign is returned, Procurement can finalize vendor setup.

Approving: Karthik Iyer
VP Finance | Redwood Inference
Attachment: procurement-addendum-signed.pdf (will be sent to vendor via DocuSign)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@microledger.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T16:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: single-invoice onboarding & PO waiver for MicroLedger trial

Jordan —

Good news: Procurement has approved a temporary invoice-only onboarding for the pilot. Conditional approval details below (please sign the DocuSign addendum we just sent):
- Spend cap: $7,500 (single invoice only)
- Validity: 90 days from vendor activation
- Required: Signed addendum (DocuSign link), W9, COI, SOW attached to vendor record
- Next steps for you: sign the DocuSign addendum (link in separate email), confirm billing contact and where we should send the invoice, and confirm pilot start date.

Once the addendum is signed, Procurement will create MicroLedger in our vendor system with the TEMP-INVOICE-TRIAL tag and we’ll notify you when you can submit the invoice at engagement close.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

Naomi Feldman
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments sent: MicroLedger_W9.pdf, MicroLedger_CertificateOfInsurance.pdf, SOW_MicroLedger_trial.pdf
